basic_details.job_title: Goa University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Technology, Assistant Professor in Sanskrit, Assistant Professor in Electronics
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% marks (5% relaxation for reserved category) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016; OR Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU). Minimum 15 years of residence in Goa and knowledge of Konkani are mandatory.

salary_details.pay_scale: No salary amount specified in the notification

how_to_apply: Register your name in the office of the Assistant Registrar (Teaching), Administrative Office, Goa University half an hour before the scheduled interview time.
Submit an application on plain paper addressed to the Registrar, Goa University, with bio-data at the time of registration.
Enclose self-attested copies of valid caste certificate, valid residence certificate and educational qualification certificates.
Produce original certificates for verification during the interview.
Attend on 17 November 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid; candidates attend at their own expense University reserves the right not to fill the position or cancel the selection process without assigning reasons; no expenses/refund payable Fulfilment of the pre-2009 Ph.D. conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned NET/SET not required for Masters disciplines in which NET/SET is not conducted

rows.post: Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Technology
rows.qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks in Computer Science / Computer Applications / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence / Information Technology or a relevant/allied subject (Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science & Technology, Information Technology & Engineering, Internet of Things, Robotics, Cyber Security, Computer Vision) with NET/SET or Ph.D.; OR Ph.D. from a top-500 foreign university

Master's degree with 55% marks in Sanskrit or a relevant/allied subject (Sanskrit Sahitya / Alankar Sastra; IKS - Bharatiya ganit / Jyotisha / Natya Sastra / Aagam Sastra) with NET/SET or Ph.D.; OR Ph.D. from a top-500 foreign university

Master's degree with 55% marks in Electronics Science or a relevant/allied subject (Robotics, Biomedical Instrumentation, Laser Technology, Micro-electronics, Data communications, Embedded System) with NET/SET or Ph.D.; OR Ph.D. from a top-500 foreign university

Qualification required: Master's degree with 55% marks in Electronics Science or a relevant/allied subject (Robotics, Biomedical Instrumentation, Laser Technology, Micro-electronics, Data communications, Embedded System) with NET/SET or Ph.D.; OR Ph.D. from a top-500 foreign university.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Goa University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Goa University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 3 Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Technology, 2 Assistant Professor in Sanskrit, 1 Assistant Professor in Electronics.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Goa University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Council Hall, Administrative Block, Goa University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No salary amount specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree with at least 55% marks (5% relaxation for reserved category) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016; OR Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU). Minimum 15 years of residence in Goa and knowledge of Konkani are mandatory. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Minimum of 15 years of residence in Goa (mandatory). Knowledge of Konkani (mandatory).

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the prescribed qualification and essential conditions will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection by walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis (Temporary) for the Second Term of academic year 2026-27 or until regular faculty joins, whichever is earlier. No claim whatsoever for any permanent post due to this appointment.
